name: Tianshi Guojiajia
source:
Loong, angels and aliens. This is a visual novel based on the New Age worldview, blending elements of campus romance, ancient Eastern mythology, and extraterrestrial science fiction, yet maintaining a lighthearted and comedic atmosphere.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4186860]Steam[/url]]
translation:
龙，天使和外星人。这是一部基于新纪元世界观的视觉小说，融合了校园言情、东方古代神话、外星科幻等元素，同时又保持着轻松喜剧的氛围。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4186860]Steam[/url]]
